newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pechiney raises stake in Techpack.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney raises stake in Techpack.

text.p: Aluminium group Pechiney said on Monday it had raised its stake in packaging firm Financiere Techpack to 80 percent from 39 percent after acquiring 41 percent from investment funds.

Pechiney said in a statement that the acquisition of Techpack, which becomes a subsidiary as of June 30, will raise its debt by 1.4 billion francs. But Pechiney added that it had sold 2.4 billion francs of assets since the start of the year.
It said the impact on its consolidated results of an exceptional 200 million franc goodwill amortisation for Techpack assets would be entirely offset by exceptional profit gains.
Pechiney said it would offer minority shareholders in Techpack between 490 and 530 francs in a buyout bid to be presented by the end of July.

Financiere Techpack is the holding company of Techpack International, which has annual sales of around two billion francs and an operating margin of about 150 million, Pechiney said. Techpack produces plastic packaging for the perfume and cosmetics industries.
